title: MLEADERSTYLE group-179 version field domain

scope.operation: Refuse unsupported group-179 styleVersion values before output when targeting DXF versions that emit the field.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 identifies group 179 as Version (expected to have value 2), R2010 only.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct writer validation of group 179 for AC1024/AC1027 only; no general MLEADERSTYLE version support claim.

implementation: Require styleVersion == 2 for targets AC1024 or later, where group 179 is emitted.
Leave AC1021 behavior unchanged because group 179 is absent there.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.refusal: For both AC1024 and AC1027, each invalid value refuses before publication; the destination sentinel and caller model value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries each case with styleVersion=2; emitted group 179 is exactly 2.
evidence.matrix: Three invalid values × two target versions × two encodings; 12 destination-safe refusals and 12 successful retries. Existing version matrix confirms group 179 is absent for AC1021.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE version-specific fields, source-presence profiles and native semantics remain open.
